journey.title: This is your first phase.
journey.body: Your journey continues as you log your workouts and progress.

success.title: Your base is selected.
success.body: {{templateId}} · {{split}}. Your final sessions are versioned and ready.

requiresClearance.title: More information is needed
requiresClearance.body: We identified a condition that needs extra care before safe personalization. Follow your responsible professional's guidance and update your answers when no unrepresented restrictions remain.

blocked.title: Workout paused for safety
blocked.body: Your current answers activate a documented safety stop. AJ Fit will not prescribe a workout in this state.

needsQuestionnaireUpdate.title: Update your information
needsQuestionnaireUpdate.body: Some answers required for safe selection are missing or come from an older questionnaire.

unavailable.title: Workout not available yet
unavailable.body: A safe composition rule required by your answers has not been defined. No generic workout was generated.

cta.label: I want to start
cta.footer: See the available options in the next step.
